rv.q: And yes, it’s a campy show of raunchy puns and ill-fitting wigs, served with a side of beefcake. But the Ilya and Shane on stage are Broadway veterans Jay Armstrong Johnson and Jimin Moon, and they not only offer spot-on impersonations of the cocky Russian and the amiable Canadian; there are moments when their talent helps turn this lark into sa...
Thoroughly enjoyable, knowingly silly, and affectionate without becoming smug, Heated Rivalry: The Unauthorized Musical Parody understands precisely what fandom wants from a send-up like this.
